title: Visual Derivative Worker
objective: Implement governed visual derivative generation for reusable resources while preserving source identity, lineage and ARI-11 use-capability enforcement.

matching_red.reason: Focused ARI-12 regression/profile existed while the production visual-derivative-worker module was intentionally absent; exact-head Linux client typecheck failed with TS2307 for visual-derivative-worker.

completion_summary: Implemented a deterministic storage-neutral visual derivative contract for bounded thumbnails, previews, transparent-display and cropped-display derivatives with dimension and dominant-color metadata. ARI-11 transform capability is fail-closed, ARI-03 derived-from edges retain source identity and content address at generation, original bytes/source truth remain unchanged, invalid crops are rejected deterministically, and no audio, provider, rights-promotion, redistribution/commercial or release authority is introduced.

changed_since_previous: ARI-11 reached completed_verified and its authority was retired
ARI-12 governed start activated only its bounded branch
matching RED was positively observed with the production module absent
the first minimal GREEN production head passed exact-head Linux, Windows and deterministic comparison
application PR #456 squash-merged the exact validated head

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-10
owner_sequence_authorization.rule: Execute strictly in order; each unit retains its own bounded scope, validation, integration, closeout, and strict-successor selection.

selection_boundaries: ARI-11 remains completed_verified and owns evidence-backed rights/license/use-capability evaluation and downstream filtering.
ARI-12 owns bounded visual derivative records for thumbnails, previews, transparent/cropped display derivatives and dimension/color metadata only.
Source identity, original bytes and ARI-03 provenance remain preserved; visual derivative creation cannot grant rights, provider entitlement, redistribution or commercial permission.
ARI-13 audio derivative work and all later ARI implementation were not begun by ARI-12.
next_action: ARI-13 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority; the next execution Continue may governed-start only ARI-13.
